div.div: 1 · Found on 26 November: Cloudflare returned /rag/health, /rag/openapi.json and Open WebUI's /chat/api/config from its cache (HIT, max-age 3600). The cached config was 32 minutes old and still said onboarding: true, though the admin account existed. Responses marked no-store (the auth endpoints) bypass the cache.
